pages.text: Health 80, knockback resistance 0.6, movement speed 0.26. Basic attack: throws ice blocks for 4-6 direct damage and 4-6 splash damage.$(br)Upgrades$(br)$(l)Chilling Focus$(): permanent Chill Hide III; gives frost-type servants within 10 blocks Chill Hide I.

$(l)Frost Nova Focus$(): ice blocks have a 75%% chance to add a Frost Nova that ignores invulnerability frames; attack speed increases.$(br)$(l)Cairn Necromancer Soul Jar$(): +40 health, permanent Bitter Cold aura, and attacks have a 10%% chance to summon 3-5 Snow Golem servants to help (cap 6, 8-second cooldown).
$(l)Maxed$(): +2 ice damage, +5 armor, a new look, and +0.5 knockback resistance.
